correctness.rationale: The class-wide statement is exactly equivalent to containment of e^{lambda D} in the standard parabolic uniform-convexity domain, because the source provides a canonical extremal realizing the full exponential generator. Taking the principal logarithm reduces the threshold to a boundary-distance problem. The boundary is parametrized explicitly, its logarithmic distance has derivative 4N/D, and the proof establishes a unique positive zero of N globally. The extremal gives an interior equality point for every lambda above the threshold.
